answers.how: The cat moves approximately 118 px in 2.042 s, giving a scale of 55.5 px/m from its known speed. Its length including the tail is about 48 px.
Using the motion-derived scale of 55.5 px/m, the cat's approximately 35 px vertical extent including its tail gives 0.63 m.
The central beach chair is approximately 85 px wide. Dividing by the cat-derived scale of 55.5 px/m gives 1.53 m.
Adjacent pool-tile boundaries are approximately 66.5 px apart horizontally. At 55.5 px/m, this is 1.20 m.
The swimming ring spans approximately 72 px horizontally. Using 55.5 px/m gives 1.30 m.
The swimming ring spans approximately 59 px vertically. Using 55.5 px/m gives 1.06 m.
Tracking the ring across frames near 0.5 s gives approximately 105 px/s. Dividing by the cat-derived scale of 55.5 px/m gives 1.89 m/s.
